KimonoGirlNaokoSeenText:
You have lovely
#MON. May I see them in battle?
KimonoGirlNaokoAfterBattleText:
I enjoyed that
bout. I would like to see you again.
KimonoGirlSayoSeenText:
I always dance
with my #MON.

Of course, I also
train them.
KimonoGirlSayoBeatenText:
Oh, so close!
I almost had you.
KimonoGirlSayoAfterBattleText:
Rhythm is impor-
tant for both

dancing and #-
MON.
KimonoGirlZukiSeenText:
Isn't my barrette
pretty?

Oh. A #MON
battle?
KimonoGirlZukiAfterBattleText:
I put a different
flower in my bar- rette every month.
KimonoGirlKuniSeenText:
Oh, you're a cute
trainer. Would you like to battle?
KimonoGirlKuniAfterBattleText:
I trained a lot,
so I thought I was

a capable trainer.
I guess I'm not.
KimonoGirlMikiSeenText:
Do you like my
dancing? I'm good at #MON too.
KimonoGirlMikiAfterBattleText:
I can keep dancing
because there are

people who enjoy
what I do.

My #MON keep my
spirits up too.
SurfGuyNeverLeftAScratchText:
Not only are the
KIMONO GIRLS great

dancers, they're
also skilled at #MON.

I always challenge
them, but I've

never even left a
scratch…
SurfGuyLadGiftText:
Lad! If you can
defeat all the

KIMONO GIRLS, I'll
give you a gift.
SurfGuyLassieGiftText:
Lassie, if you can
defeat all the

KIMONO GIRLS, I'll
give you a gift.
SurfGuyLikeADanceText:
The way you bat-
tled, it was like watching a dance.

It was a rare
treat to see!

I want you to have
this. Don't worry --take it!
SurfGuySurfExplanationText:
That's SURF.

It's a move that
lets #MON swim across water.
SurfGuyElegantKimonoGirlsText:
I wish my #MON
were as elegant as the KIMONO GIRLS…
DanceTheaterCooltrainerMText:
That man's always
with his RHYDON.

Says he wants a
#MON that can SURF and dance.

Is he trying to
make a synchro- nized swimming #MON?
DanceTheaterGrannyText:
The KIMONO GIRLS
are so beautiful…

But they have to
go through rigor- ous training.

And they have to
learn to follow

customs before ap-
pearing in public.

But if you love
something, any- thing is possible.
DanceTheaterFancyPanelText:
It's a fancy panel
that's decorated with flowers.
